title: Meeting decision register
summary: Help the project team capture decisions and their owners from meeting notes.

records.text: The project team needs a draft decision register with the decision and its owner.
Is this an on-demand agent skill used by the project team?

rounds.name: Confirm the type and capture tentative views

records.text: Yes, it is an on-demand agent skill. It only drafts locally. I need to check whether the source notes contain private information. I prefer Markdown for review.

records.resolution: Stakeholder confirmed the on-demand agent skill.

records.text: The stakeholder favors Markdown for team review.
Meeting notes usually name a decision owner.
Always include an explicit owner field, even when the source omits it.
What kinds of information do the meeting notes contain?
Who can review the draft and its source notes?

rounds.name: Confirm sensitivity and an output decision

records.text: The notes can include named personnel matters. Missing owners may be inferred and shown if labeled tentative.

records.resolution: Stakeholder confirmed the notes can contain sensitive personnel information.

records.text: Show inferred owners with a tentative label when the meeting notes omit the owner.
Names must not appear in the decision register unless the source explicitly names the decision owner.
The output rule allows tentative names while the records policy requires an explicit source.
Which rule governs when the source omits the owner?

rounds.name: Resolve and preserve the original decision

records.text: Follow the records policy. Use 'unassigned' when the source omits the owner.
Use 'unassigned' when the source omits the owner.

records.resolution: Replaced by explicit-owners-only after stakeholder confirmation.
The stakeholder confirmed that the records policy governs.
Use 'unassigned' when the source omits the owner.
